name: Modified semi-defined media (SDM) (PMC13185528)
description: modified semi-defined media (SDM), a defined medium extracted from Spiga et al. (2026). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Spiga et al. An anaerobic pathogen rewires host metabolism to fuel oxidative growth in the inflamed gut. Cell (2026). DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2026.04.012. [PMC13185528]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: modified semi-defined media (SDM) (1.5 g/L KH2PO4, 0.5 g/L NH4SO4, 0.9 g/L NaCl, 150 mg/L L-methionine, 5 µg/L vitamin B12, 1 mg/L resazurin, 1 g/L tryptone, 0.2% NaHCO3, 0.005% protoporphyrin IX) sup). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
